method: Blind pairwise judgment by 16 fresh Claude Sonnet subagents (medium effort), 5 pairs each, given only the topic, a 5-point rubric (correctness, idea visible, legibility, completeness, layout) and two 1600x900 board images. Every topic judged twice with sides swapped; a topic goes to a system that wins both orders or wins one and ties the other, otherwise even.
